comparator.name: Economics & Society
comparator.sourceNotes: Fresh current official product verifies twelve first-year and twelve selected second-year 5-EC units. The 10-EC Package A (European Law and Social Law) is instantiated by published order; Package B is excluded. The guide explicitly defers Year 3 to 2027–2028, so only 120 EC are retained and no advanced, elective or thesis credit is invented.
